aether.description: Aether belief substrate — persistent, contradiction-aware trust state across models and sessions. Call aether_context at session start for a snapshot. Use aether_search for memory recall with trust + contradiction metadata. Use aether_correct to trigger belief backprop when the user corrects a claim. crt_get_user_context for session-start personalization; crt_get_pending_fact_checks for prior mistakes to acknowledge; crt_fact_check_response before asserting user facts; crt_search_sessions for past-session recall.

groundcheck.description: Trust-weighted memory primitives (standalone GroundCheck). Use groundcheck_check at turn start, groundcheck_verify before asserting factual claims, groundcheck_store for explicit corrections.
